report.summary: daedalus/structcore/imports.py: Handles all-language import extraction (extract_imports) and internal resolution (resolve_internal) for non-Python files, using tree-sitter or regex fallback, with best-effort mapping to repo files.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/structcore/imports.py|Module docstring claims all-language import extraction and internal resolution.
todos: daedalus/structcore/imports.py|function|extract_imports|Returns list of (raw, kind) import tuples for non-Python files; returns [] for Python.
daedalus/structcore/imports.py|function|resolve_internal|Maps an internal raw import string to a repo file path (posix) or None, best-effort for non-Python.
